articles.summary: Darden Restaurants, Inc. (NYSE:DRI) today reported its financial results for the first quarter ended August 30, 2026. First Quarter 2027 Financial Highlights Total sales increased 5.1% to $3.2 billion. Blended same-restaurant sales 1 for the quarter increased 3.1% on a fiscal calendar basis and increased 3.2% on a comparable calendar basis.
